principle: NO pre-stored banks; live encyclopedia fetch only; maximum parallel tool-using agents; separate checker agents at every step; search = integrity check not novelty gate.

convergence.notes: Algorithm-improvement is the evaluated quantity, not niche count (R9).

update_log.rationale: Cold start. Default params chosen for a generous-but-bounded fan-out: 6 knowledge branches (broad human-knowledge coverage + 1 newest-ML branch), redundancy 2 at the integrity stage where fabrication risk is highest. Counts are tunable and intended to scale up as cost budget allows.
